item.title: Hotfix 1.13.2 patch notes
item.description:
Warband!

Hotfix 1.13.2 is now being rolled out on all platforms, and while you wait for it to download you can read the notes below!

This hotfix contains various fixes to several bugs and crashes.

Hotfix 1.13.2 patch notes
Features & Tweaks

  • (Havoc) During the Prophet of Decay bossfight, the Havoc Specialist enemies spawn reduction modifier now applies through the whole end event encounter, instead of only during specific phases.

Fixes
General Fixes

  • (Havoc) Fixed an issue where Monstrosities spawned through the Specialists system could fail to spawn with the appropriate weakened health.

  • Fixed a rare crash occurring during the first elevator ride in Spillway.

  • Enemy behaviour is now more standardised when teams split paths in Spillway.

  • Fixed a rare crash occurring when hotjoining during the boss fight at the end of Spillway.

  • Fixed a rare crash occurring when players are inspecting another player in the Mourning Star, potentially when the other player is disconnecting.

  • Fixed an issue where the Psyker's "The Quickening" and "Seer's Presence" Auras could cause Ability Cooldowns to calculate incorrectly, causing untended increases in Ability Charges.

  • Fixed an issue where there could be difficulties tagging enemies that were a long distance away.

  • Fixed an occasional crash caused by lag spikes during gameplay.

  • Fixed incorrect names for Terror In The Depths penance rewards.

  • Updated the networking library version, resolving an issue that could cause a "Backend Error" for some players when signing in.

Cosmetic Fixes

  • Fixed an issue with lighting on the face while wearing the ‘Faithbound Flak Helm’ head cosmetic.

  • Added missing candle flame on the 'Krieg Vigil Greatcoat (Krieg 143rd)’ upper body cosmetic.

  • Fixed a few visual issues with ‘Faithbound Flak Vest’ upper body cosmetic.

Known Issues

  • New Penances related to Spillway mention finishing missions on Damnation on the Auric mission board, when it should instead mention finishing missions on Auric difficulty.

  • New Penances related to Spillway mention the Sedition difficulty that no longer exists.

That’s all for today!

We’ll see you on the Mourningstar. 

– The Darktide Team

item.description:
